drhp.business: Polyplex manufactures a diversified portfolio of polymeric films - BOPET (thin and thick), BOPP, CPP and Blown PP/PE - along with captive PET resin, serving global customers across packaging, electrical & electronics, industrial and specialty applications. Its backward-integrated model (captive PET resin at every film-manufacturing location) is combined with forward/downstream capabilities such as metallizing, coating and holography, and its D-PAC (Differentiated Products, Applications and Customers) strategy is a key pillar of growth into high-value specialty markets.

risks.note: The Company evaluates shifting some floating-rate debt to fixed rate based on cost-benefit analysis; management notes the impact of significant interest rate movements is minimal as the Company is net cash positive.
risks.risk: Interest rate risk on floating-rate debt

risks.note: Customers span ~85 countries with unsecured/open payment terms, and risk is accentuated by geopolitical uncertainties and economic disruption in certain regions; mitigated by an internal credit management system and global credit insurance cover, though the average credit period rose to 58 days in FY25-26 from 54 days in FY24-25.
risks.risk: Credit risk from a globally dispersed customer base

risks.note: Delay in implementation, cost overrun, inability to stabilize production from new investments, or failure to meet target investment objectives could significantly affect future profitability; flagged specifically for the new BOPET film line in India and smaller specialty-portfolio projects in India and Turkey.
risks.risk: Project implementation risk on new capex

risks.note: Ongoing conflicts (including the Middle East), trade tensions and political instability can disrupt supply chains, impact demand, and increase volatility in raw material, energy and logistics costs and currency, despite the Company's diversified manufacturing footprint providing some resilience.

Reliance on international shipping and logistics exposes the Company to disruption via critical routes such as the Red Sea and Strait of Hormuz, which can raise freight costs, extend transit times and affect container availability.

Extensive food-safety regulation by bodies such as the USFDA and the EC governs packaging materials across jurisdictions; non-compliance risk is managed through internal processes and continuous monitoring of regulatory developments.

Exposure to fire incidents, workplace accidents, equipment failures and unauthorized facility access could lead to injury or loss of life, asset damage, operational disruption, financial loss and reputational harm; mitigated via a Health & Safety framework covering fire/emergency management and workplace safety systems.
risks.risk: Health, safety and security risk at manufacturing sites
